comment: A third country to the common system of VAT of Directive 2006/112/EC,
article 5(2), which applies only in the territory of the Community as
defined by the Treaties. Eswatini (named Swaziland until 2018) levies its
own value added tax under the Value Added Tax Act, 2011 (Act No. 12 of
2011). `vat_prefix` is null: an Eswatini taxpayer is identified by the
Taxpayer Identification Number the Eswatini Revenue Service assigns, which
territories.name: Eswatini
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and Eswatini is a third country to it. Eswatini levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act, 2011 (Act No. 12 of 2011), section 3, at a rate of fifteen per cent (15 %) since 1 August 2018 (Legal Notice No. 112 of 2018), with a rate of zero per cent (0 %) on exports and the supplies of the Second Schedule, and the exempt supplies of the First Schedule.
